title.zh: 大语言模型的逐词采样

description.zh: 每一步把分数用 softmax 变成概率，用温度整形，用 top-k / top-p 截断，再随机抽一个词。分数是手工设定的玩具数据，不是真实模型输出。
description.en: At each step scores become probabilities via softmax, temperature reshapes them, top-k / top-p trim the tail and one word is drawn at random. Scores are hand-set toy data, not real model outputs.

reason.zh: 逐词生成就是反复从一个离散概率分布中抽样；抽得越多，频率越接近该分布。
reason.en: Generating word by word is repeated sampling from a discrete probability distribution; the more draws, the closer the frequencies get to it.

reason.zh: 注意力权重和下一词概率都由 softmax 得到；温度相当于第 1 步锐度 β 的倒数。
reason.en: Attention weights and next-word probabilities both come from softmax; temperature acts as the inverse of the sharpness β in the attention page's step 1.

title.zh: 模型怎样一个词一个词写出句子？
title.en: How does a model write a sentence word by word?
